## Pickup rules
Bulky-item pickup is available for residential customers by appointment, with up to three large household items per pickup. Mattresses, sofas, and chairs are accepted when placed at the curb by 7:00 a.m. on the scheduled day.

## Restrictions
Construction debris, refrigerators, tires, and hazardous waste are not accepted through bulky-item pickup.
